cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What do you gain if your cousin beats me in the club election? I taught you to read proposals past the candidate's name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fine heading. Now give me the line underneath, as we practised: which proposal of his makes your life better than mine would?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He'll resurface the car park. You want a new roof; I keep paying to fix my tyres.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So you measure competence by what it saves you. Put us in order on that basis: am I behind him because of the tyres, or is there another test I haven't seen?

reason: Ground the exact paired behavior in remembered pupil habits and a specific immediate ask. Complete all three measurement/gain/rank dimensions where required, and keep unrevealed stakes visibly withheld rather than inventing them.
